newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian defence minister postpones Murmansk trip.
newsitem.headline: Russian defence minister postpones Murmansk trip.

text.p: Russia's Defence Minister Igor Rodionov has put off a planned trip to a northern base on Tuesday in a move which could indicate President Boris Yeltsin's heart operation is imminent.
Interfax news agency quoted the defence ministry press service on Monday as saying Rodionov's visit to the Northern Fleet, based near Murmansk, would take place at a later date.
Yeltsin's operation was not mentioned. But analysts said it would be highly unusual for the defence minister to be away from the capital while Yeltsin, who is commander-in-chief, undergoes surgery.
No day or time has yet been announced for Yeltsin's bypass operation but his doctors said on Monday he was in satisfactory condition.
